title: MSBuild Guard Trust Store Schema
description: Validation schema for MSBuild Guard trust stores.

version.description: The trust store schema version. Default is 1.

decisions.description: List of trust and exception decisions evaluated by MSBuild Guard.

decisionId.description: A unique identifier (GUID or string) representing this decision.

scope.description: The scope of the trust decision. Matches the fingerprinting resolution strategy.

subjectHash.description: The target hash, rule fingerprint, package identifier (e.g. package@version), or signer key being approved.

decision.description: The kind of decision applied to this subject.

reason.description: An audit-compliant reason explaining why this trust was granted.

assemblySigner.description: Optional certificate signer display name (for Assembly or Signer scopes).

assemblyIssuer.description: Optional certificate issuer (for Signer or Assembly scopes).

repositoryRemote.description: Optional remote repository URL filter constraint.

userSid.description: The Security Identifier (SID) or username of the approving identity.

createdAtUtc.description: ISO date-time indicating when the decision was recorded.

expiresAtUtc.description: Optional ISO date-time specifying when this decision expires and is no longer trusted.
